messages.subject: International Executive | Mining, ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear John,

Fairmount Consultants' senior leadership search work across complex international markets makes this a relevant introduction. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates across mining, resources, energy and infrastructure where growth depends on disciplined stakeholder and institutional engagement. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
